autoFilters.title: Auto filters
autoFilters.intro: Queue junk tags automatically when your vault loads or refreshes. Keeps and favorites are never auto-tagged.
autoFilters.rulesBody: Matching pieces are queued as junk in Review (same as manual junk). Keeps are never auto-tagged: DIM keep/favorite, pending keep, or pieces you kept in a duel bucket.
autoFilters.operatorsIntro: Each filter can be <1>Is</1>, <2>Is not</2>, <3>Any of</3>, or <4>None of</4> (e.g. junk Hunter pieces whose archetype is none of Bulwark, Paragon).

sameArmorSet.label: Require same armor set
sameArmorSet.help: Only group or compare pieces from the same set. Off: same slot + archetype + tertiary across all sets.

sameTuningStat.label: Require same tuning stat
sameTuningStat.help: Split by tuning stat (e.g. Weapons vs Grenade). Off: mixed tuning stats in one bucket.

respectKeepFavorite.label: Respect DIM keep and favorite when picking junk
respectKeepFavorite.help: When on, keep- and favorite-tagged pieces are not suggested as junk in dupe flows.

excludeJunk.label: Exclude junk-tagged pieces from dupe counts

cardBody.tuning: Groups duplicates by tuning stat, even across different armor sets.

account.heading: Account

account.signOutNote: Sign out clears Bungie and DIM tokens from this browser session (session storage only). Preferences stay in local storage.

clearLocalData.heading: Local data
clearLocalData.description: Fixes stuck locale names, bad vault cache, or bad onboarding state. Signs you out and clears IndexedDB (vault and manifest per locale), session tokens, compare sessions, and pending tags. Migration flag dac-storage-migrated-v1 is cleared only on a full reset.
clearLocalData.confirm:
Clear local app data and sign out?

This removes vault cache, manifest cache, Bungie/DIM tokens, compare sessions, and pending tags from this browser.
clearLocalData.confirmResetPrefs:
Also reset calibration preferences, dupe rules, onboarding, and the storage migration flag?

Choose OK for a full reset. Cancel keeps prefs, dupe rules, onboarding, and language choice.

dupeRules.minTierHelp: Vault import still loads tiers 1 through 5. Only pieces at or above this tier enter dupe buckets and redundant-roll checks.
dupeRules.groupingIntro: Pieces always match on class, slot, archetype, and tertiary stat. These options add stricter splits, and they apply to redundant-roll comparisons too.
dupeRules.dimTagsIntro: Tagged pieces stay visible but can be left out of dupe bucket sizes and review counts.
